definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of closing a wound or surgical incision by sewing it together with thread or other materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縫合|ほうごう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切開部|せっかいぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縫合|ほうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the surgery, the incision is sutured closed.

examples.japanese: {縫合|ほうごう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一週間後|いっしゅうかんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The stitches in the sutured area are scheduled to be removed in one week.

notes:
A compound of {縫|ほう} (to sew) and ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (to join together). A medical term used in hospitals and clinics. While it is a technical word, it is commonly understood by the general public since stitching wounds is a familiar medical procedure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縫合|ほうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to suture
- {縫合|ほうごう}{糸|し}: suture thread
- ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縫合|ほうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stitch a wound
- {縫合|ほうごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to remove stitches

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{抜糸|ばっし}→抜糸：17775_basshi⟧: removal of stitches — the follow-up procedure after {縫合|ほうごう}
- {切開|せっかい}: incision — cutting open tissue, the opposite action
- ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧: wound, cut — what gets sutured
